items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I was going around with J.C. Heard, and Jo Jones. That's the three of us that was hanging out together, and we'd go to all these places and we would play.

ctx.x: And who else? There's 3 or 4 others, and I've heard an awful lot of drummers say that ...
Yeah, and Jo Jones danced, you know.
I don't believe I remember that.
